card.name: Time unit ending a dose rate
card.fires_on: The time word (day, daily, week, weeks) that completes a dosing rate or interval right after a dose amount, such as mg/m2/day or every 3 weeks.

modes.label: Per-time rate
modes.description: The time unit after a slash following mg/m2 in a dose rate.
modes.example: daunorubicin hydrochloride injection 45 mg/m 2 /<<day>> IV on days 1, 2
